compatibility.detail: Use a listing that explicitly names original Qrevo or 2R3W. The filter and kit above exclude several newer Qrevo variants.
Original Qrevo uses one full-width rubber roller. A DuoDivide roller set is a different assembly.
These can cover more than one model, but check each listing separately. Shared bags do not prove shared filters.

careTip: Let a rinsed washable filter dry for 24 hours before reinstalling it. Remove hair from roller ends before assuming the brush needs replacing. Switch off the robot before servicing it.

questions.question: Will a Qrevo S or S5V kit fit the original Qrevo?
questions.answer: Do not assume it will. The filter and complete kit linked here specifically target the original model, while newer models can use different filters or rollers. Check compatibility for every component in a kit.

questions.question: Should I buy a kit or one replacement part?
questions.answer: Choose the single part if that is all you need. A kit is useful when several consumables are due or you want spares; compare quantities and the live price rather than assuming every kit is cheaper.

questions.question: Are these genuine Roborock parts?
questions.answer: The dust-bag pack is Roborock branded. The other five listings are third-party replacements and are labeled separately. Listing compatibility is not a DustMigo fit, durability or filtration test.
